name: Fireflies.ai
summary: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes and summarizes your calls across Zoom, Google Meet and Teams — searchable notes, action items and CRM sync, so nobody takes minutes by hand.
best_for: teams that want every meeting transcribed and searchable automatically — the free unlimited-transcription tier is genuinely rare
skip_if: your meetings involve sensitive topics where an AI notetaker joining calls raises consent or confidentiality questions — check policy first
honest_knock: The advertised $10 and $19 are annual-billing rates; month-to-month is $18 and $29. And AI credits are capped on every tier — Pro carries the same 20 a month as the free plan, so upgrading to Pro buys recording and storage rather than more AI. If you mainly want real-time in-Zoom captioning and simple English notes, Otter is the simpler pick.

pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-08-31 against the vendor's own pricing page, read from a European exit) Free $0 — unlimited transcription, limited AI summaries, 400 mins storage per team, 20 AI credits. Pro $18/seat/mo month-to-month or $10/seat/mo billed annually — unlimited AI summaries, 8,000 mins storage per seat, 20 AI credits. Business $29/seat/mo month-to-month or $19/seat/mo billed annually — unlimited storage, 30 AI credits. Enterprise $39/seat/mo, annual only — 50 AI credits, SSO/SCIM, HIPAA, private storage. CORRECTION to the previous dossier: $10 and $19 were carried as the price; they are the annual rates and month-to-month is 80% and 53% higher. Enterprise was missing entirely. The AI-credit ladder (20/20/30/50) means Pro adds no AI credits over the free plan.
